notes.title: DUAL WIELD UPDATE released!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28254103/8c04e29a8d25a2683c64d456bc9b22baceb2f48c.png[/img]
Citizens of Anarchy Town! Long wait is over. Grab your weapons and prepare for a new wave of anarchy! DUAL WIELD UPDATE is finally released! This is the biggest update ever! It includes everything that is required to have some fun on the burning streets of Anarchy Town. Check out the list of new stuff!

[h1][b]Dual wield feature[/b][/h1]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xULW8hXs4103o7CdQQ/giphy.gif[/img]
What is the point to have two hands if you can hold only one gun? YES! Now you can carry two weapons and shoot from them by pressing Left or Right mouse button. Main guns have good range and accuracy - excellent choice for keeping enemies at bay. Special guns have shorter range but deal ~20% more damage which is a serious argument in close combat. It’s time to learn some new strategies on the battlefield!

[h1][b]New guns[/b][/h1]
Arm dealing business is booming, there are tons of new guns in town! Grenade launchers, slime shooters, laser rifles, weird alien guns... There are so many new ways to wreak mayhem and destruction!

[h1][b]Random gun drops[/b][/h1]
Bosses in the most stages now drop different guns! Replay levels if you want to try the whole arsenal!

[h1][b]Kick master talent[/b][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28254103/a5d7dc68b1db4e12263a4d75cff0e38ec30648ba.png[/img]
Learn this talent to push back and damage enemies by touching them! It’s time to kick some ass!

[h1][b]Red enemies[/b][/h1]
These are tough fellas that need to be taken care of. They provide better loot and always drop a medkit.

[h1][b]New explosions[/b][/h1]
Destroyed cars and turrets now are shattered to pieces that damage and stun nearby enemies. Good for going out with a bang!

[h1][b]New special effects[/b][/h1]
Clouds, bullet marks and bloody splashes will make your eyes happy!

[h1][b]Balance tweaks[/b][/h1]
All medkits effectiveness was increased by 25%. Stay healthy!
Weapon upgrades prices were dropped dramatically. It’s time to gear up!

[h1][b]Russian localization[/b][/h1]
And it’s only the beginning! Expect more languages soon…

We spend a lot of time to bring these cool features in the game! You can help us by [h1][b]writing reviews on Steam[/b][/h1] and spreading the word about this game! Let’s keep this wheel rolling, give us your support and we’ll bring even more new features in the game!
Anarchy never ends!

notes.title: DUAL WIELD update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28254103/83b0f0009a04b4c386311686206eb3a0b5f198fc.png[/img]
When I started working on Master of Mayhem, I considered it a vastly expanded remake of the original State of Anarchy game. I wanted to add new things without changing it too much. However in time I realized that linear weapon progression inherited from the original game removes a good chunk of variety from gameplay. Now we’re gonna fix that in 3 steps.
[b]Step 1 - dual wield![/b] Hero can carry two guns and shoot from them using Right and Left mouse buttons. This gives a player more flexibility in different combat situations. Double impact!
[b]Step 2 - random gun drop![/b] On some levels bosses will drop random gun from a drop list instead of one predefined gun like before. This will improve replayability of the levels. The show must go on!
[b]Step 3 - new guns![/b] New weapon types will be added, such as grenade launcher. Total number of weapons in the game goes up to 53 guns. Excellent!

Please, support us by writing reviews on Steam. Every review makes a difference!

notes.title: Patch 1.01 is here!
notes.content:
Hello, citizens of Anarchy Town!
[b]Patch 1.01 is here![/b]
- Alien flyers now move much slower
For unknown reason alien flyers became way to fast. I was shocked to see them flying across the screen on ultra high speed in the game build. Now they are much slower so the player has enough time to react and shot them down before they leave the screen.
- Turret density in the fifth alien planet stage has been reduced
This stage was supposed to provide a major challenge for an average player. In reality it turned out to be a nightmare even for veterans. I removed several turrets and increased gaps between them in order to provide fair challenge rather than anger and frustration.
- Fire is spreading! Mid and high level bank floors are now on fire. Watch out, it burns!
The town has three states of destruction. I planned to do the same with bank floors, but didn’t have enough time to do so earlier. Also I intend to add even more damage to banks in later patches.
- Sound volume was adjusted
Several sounds in the game were too loud, that was fixed.
- Problems with savegames were solves
When the patch was almost ready I made a stupid mistake that reset game progress. Thanks to The Stranger’s report this issue was fixed really quick. Big ups to you, vigilant citizen! If there are game developers out there - heed the warning! Always double check you game build before release!

Andy Jr out.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/eaFmIqK.jpg[/img]
